seoTitle: AWS Architecture Journey | Built By Raza
seoDescription: Documenting my hands-on journey through AWS architecture, cloud networking and resilient infrastructure.

hero.heading: AWS Architecture Journey
hero.introduction: Building cloud architecture skills by designing, testing and documenting real AWS environments.

sections.heading: Extending a networking foundation into cloud architecture.

paragraphs.text: My background is in telecommunications, networking and solution architecture. AWS is the next layer I’m adding to that foundation.
Rather than learning only for a certification exam, I want to build real environments, understand the design decisions behind them and document what happens when things work — and when they fail.

items.title: Production-Style VPC
items.description: Public and private subnets, routing, Internet Gateway, NAT, security groups and multi-AZ design.

items.title: Highly Available Application
items.description: Load balancing, Auto Scaling, EC2 and resilient database design.

items.title: Multi-VPC Architecture
items.description: Production, development and shared-services VPCs connected through Transit Gateway.

items.title: Hybrid Cloud
items.description: Connecting enterprise infrastructure to AWS using VPN, Direct Connect concepts and BGP.

items.title: Infrastructure as Code
items.description: Rebuilding AWS environments using Terraform and reusable modules.

items.title: Cloud + AI Infrastructure
items.description: Exploring how cloud architecture connects to GPU workloads and modern AI infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: For each topic, I plan to build a working environment first, then deliberately test failure scenarios and routing behavior.
Each completed lab will include architecture diagrams, design notes, lessons learned and eventually Terraform code in GitHub.
